title: Replace bcf_unpack with pure Rust binary BCF decoder
description: Replace bcf_unpack FFI call (~68 lines) with pure Rust. This is the highest-value leaf: it unlocks 10+ BCF record modification functions (bcf_update_id, bcf_add_id, bcf_update_filter, bcf_add_filter, bcf_remove_filter, bcf_update_alleles, bcf_update_info, bcf_update_format, bcf_translate, vcf_format). The function unpacks variable-length encoded binary BCF fields. Complexity: medium-high (binary format parsing). Used throughout src/bcf/record.rs.
